agent_visual_policy.world_wardrobe_brief: Bureaucratic attire for a world of licensed gravity. Outfits emphasize physical weight, stability, and civic rank through heavy ceramic ballast, brass hardware, and cobalt glass accents. Silhouettes are bottom-heavy to reflect the struggle against drift.
visual_consistency_rules: Ballast must be rendered as solid geometric blocks
Brass elements must have 1-pixel gold highlights
No transparency except for cobalt glass props

visual_canon.lighting: Clinical overhead fluorescent with sharp graphite shadows and brass specular glints
architecture: Glass floor panels showing deep voids
Recessed wall niches for ballast storage

terrain.ground: Bone-white ceramic grid with cobalt glass inserts
terrain.path: Vermilion vector lines etched into floor
terrain.edge: Brass trim borders and graphite shadow gaps

sprite_language.role_readability: Color-coded brass badges and heavy ballast backpacks
